title: Google Workspace
blurb: Gmail, Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Meet and Chrome sign-in.

remedies.title: Gmail won't load or is very slow
remedies.why: Extensions, a full browser cache, or a temporary Google problem.

steps.text: Try a private window; if it works, an extension is the cause.
Clear cookies for mail.google.com and sign in again.
Check google.com/appsstatus for outages.
Try the basic HTML view or another browser.

remedies.title: "You need access" to a Google Doc or Drive file
remedies.why: The file is shared with a different Google account than the one you're using.

steps.text: Check which account you're signed in with (picture at the top right); switch to the one it was shared with.
Use Request access, or ask the owner to share with the account you use.
Work files may only be shared inside your organisation.

remedies.title: Google keeps opening the wrong account (personal vs work)
remedies.why: The first account you signed into becomes the default in that browser.

steps.text: Use separate Chrome profiles for work and personal (picture at the top › Add).
Or sign out of all accounts and sign into the main one first.

remedies.title: Google Meet camera, mic or screen share doesn't work
remedies.why: The browser or system blocks access, or the wrong device is picked.

steps.text: Click the camera icon in the address bar › Allow; pick devices in Meet's ⋮ › Settings.
Allow the browser to use the camera, microphone and (Mac) screen recording.
Allow the browser to use the camera and microphone.

remedies.title: Use Google Docs, Sheets or Drive offline
remedies.why: Offline mode keeps recent files available in Chrome; Drive for desktop keeps files on the computer.

steps.text: Drive › Settings › Offline: turn it on (Chrome or Edge with the Docs Offline extension).
Right-click a file › Available offline.
Google Drive for desktop can mirror files locally.

remedies.title: Google storage is full (Gmail can't receive)
remedies.why: Gmail, Drive and Photos share one storage quota; when full, mail stops arriving.

steps.text: one.google.com/storage › Clean up space shows large items.
Search Gmail for has:attachment larger:10M and delete.
Empty Drive's Trash and Gmail's Trash and Spam.

remedies.title: Excel file looks wrong in Google Sheets (or the other way)
remedies.why: Macros, some formulas and formatting don't convert between the two.

steps.text: Open Excel files in Sheets for viewing; edit complex ones in Excel.
File › Download › Microsoft Excel to send back as .xlsx.
VBA macros don't run in Sheets (Apps Script is different).

remedies.title: Chrome says "Sync is paused"
remedies.why: Chrome lost its Google sign-in (cookies cleared or password changed).

steps.text: Click the profile picture › Sign in again.
Allow cookies for accounts.google.com if you block cookies.
